summary: Franklin Covey Co. filed an 8-K solely to announce the date and access details for its third-quarter fiscal 2026 earnings conference call scheduled for July 1, 2026. The filing contains no terms involving any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. It is a routine operational announcement of an earnings call date with instructions for webcast and telephone participation. No financial results, transaction details, or board recommendations are provided, and there are no deal terms to report.
